block.field: AI Even/Odd Switcher armed — 5 ticks, selective entry. An internal statistical ensemble scores both sides and switches between Even and Odd when its estimate changes. Entries require fresh quotes for both sides and a positive one-sigma modelled EV floor. Quotes and estimates can be wrong; execution may differ. Test on demo first.
Entry held: check the quote freshness, session limits, stake percentage, record, market readability and trade cap. The journal's decision is a model, not a guarantee.
Session brake: loss, target, drawdown, loss streak or trade limit reached. Review before restarting.
